metaShifts.theme: Force Staff Mobility Nerf Amplifies Positioning Meta
metaShifts.description: Force Staff and similar abilities can no longer be used on Leashed targets, continuing the trend from 7.36's Status Resistance removal. This further reduces escape mechanisms and amplifies the positioning-based defense paradigm established in the previous patch.

Juggernaut receives comprehensive nerfs across all abilities (Blade Fury damage, Omnislash damage, Bladeform stacks, Swiftslash range/mana), while Templar Assassin faces significant damage reductions (Meld, Refraction barrier, Psi Blades range). These were likely the most oppressive carries in 7.36's new Innate/Facet system.

Eternal Shroud magic resistance reduced from 25% to 20%, continuing the systematic dismantling of spell-based itemization that began in 7.35d and accelerated in 7.36. Combined with previous cost increases, this makes intelligence cores increasingly vulnerable.

Sven receives significant buffs (+4 base strength, God's Strength damage increase), while other strength cores like Huskar, Omniknight, and Pangolier get meaningful improvements. This suggests strength cores were underperforming in the new Innate/Facet system.

synergisticWinners.synergyExplanation: Sven's +4 base strength and God's Strength buffs synergize perfectly with Heart's percentage-based strength scaling, creating massive effective HP pools during ultimate
Waveform now attacks all targets by default with 50% damage, and the Level 20 talent adds on-hit effects. Manta illusions can now benefit from Waveform's new attack mechanics
Multiple Tinker buffs (March mana reduction, Rearm mana reduction, Warp Flare mana reduction) combined with Eureka! intelligence scaling makes Octarine Core more efficient for sustained spell casting
Base armor increase and Berserker's Blood attack speed buffs enhance Armlet toggling survivability while maximizing the attack speed synergy with low HP

synergisticLosers.synergyExplanation: Omnislash damage nerfs and Swiftslash range/mana nerfs significantly reduce the value of Scepter's Swiftslash upgrade, making the 4200 gold investment less impactful
Meld damage nerfs and Psi Blades range reduction at early levels make Blink initiation less threatening, reducing the burst potential that justified the item timing
Base mana regen reduction from 0.6 to 0.2 makes early game mana sustain more difficult, reducing Bloodstone's effectiveness as a farming accelerator
Magic resistance reduction from 25% to 20% continues the trend of making intelligence cores more vulnerable, reducing the defensive value of this core item

Carry.explanation: Massive buffs with +4 base strength and God's Strength damage increase (110/150/190%) make him a dominant late-game carry with improved laning presence
Waveform buffs (mana reduction, default attacks on all targets) significantly improve farming speed and teamfight presence, with Level 20 talent adding on-hit effects
Base armor increase and Berserker's Blood attack speed buffs (170/220/270/320) enhance his aggressive carry potential and survivability

Mid.explanation: Comprehensive buffs across March of Machines (mana/damage), Rearm mana reduction, and Warp Flare mana reduction restore his farming and teamfight efficiency
Level 25 talent rework to affect all spell targets (not just Dragon Slave) significantly increases her late-game teamfight impact

Offlane.explanation: Shield Crash damage increase (70/130/190/250) improves his laning harass and teamfight contribution as an offlane initiator
Hammer of Purity damage buffs (55/80/105/130%) enhance his offlane trading and mid-game impact
Momentum buff (30% movement speed as attack speed) significantly improves his teamfight positioning and damage output

SoftSupport.explanation: Sprout damage increase (70/140/210/280) improves his farming efficiency and ganking potential as a roaming support
Summon Convert health increase (220+80 per level) makes his dominated creeps more durable in teamfights
Stone Form improvements (can cast while silenced/stunned, immediate cast behavior) enhance his teamfight utility and survivability

HardSupport.explanation: Nature's Attendants duration increase (10/11/12/13s) improves her sustain and teamfight presence as a hard support
Base damage increase and Lil' Shredder buffs improve her laning harass and mid-game impact
Health regen increase from 0.25 to 1.0 significantly improves his laning sustainability

Carry.explanation: Comprehensive nerfs across Blade Fury damage, Omnislash damage, Bladeform stacks (3% to 2%), and Swiftslash range/mana severely impact his farming and fighting efficiency
Meld damage reduction, Refraction barrier nerfs, and Psi Blades range reduction at early levels significantly weaken her burst potential and farming patterns
Tempest Double damage penalty increase (75% to 60%) reduces his late-game scaling and teamfight contribution

Mid.explanation: Base mana regen reduction from 0.6 to 0.2 severely impacts his early game sustainability and farming efficiency
Base armor reduction makes him more vulnerable in lane, particularly against physical damage dealers
Splinter Blast damage reduction (100/180/260/340 to 80/160/240/320) weakens her farming and teamfight contribution

Offlane.explanation: Coat of Blood armor gain reduction (1 to 0.4/0.6/0.8/1.0) and One Man Army strength bonus decrease (60% to 50%) weaken his scaling
Mana cost increases on Avalanche and Toss, plus Insurmountable slow resistance reduction, impact his laning and teamfight efficiency
Base health regen decrease and Dark Ascension talent nerf reduce his laning sustainability and mid-game impact

SoftSupport.explanation: Shackles damage/heal reduction and Fowl Play cooldown increase (90s to 120s) weaken his teamfight and utility contribution
Eldritch Summoning imp explosion damage reduction significantly impacts his teamfight damage output
Smoldering Resin no longer working on wards/couriers reduces his utility, though Sticky Napalm vision removal is a minor compensation

HardSupport.explanation: Curse of Avernus attack speed reduction (15/30/45/60 to 10/20/30/40) weakens his teamfight utility and carry support capability
Overwhelming Odds Shard radius reduction and Duel Scepter cooldown increase reduce her teamfight impact and utility
Base movement speed reduction (330 to 320) impacts his early game mobility and ganking potential
